Excluded in continuous mode: AML continuous runs detection rules W2, W3, W4, W5, W6, W17 each tick and records W1, W7, W8 as not run (from 1.7.1; earlier records name the rules they ran). W4 raises one alert per entity per week, and W5 screens payments as they arrive, with no rescreen of earlier payments when a list version is published. Its results depend on when detection ran relative to arrival, so two continuous runs cannot show the same results.
